meta.name: ASTRAWILD FRESH MACHINE CHECKLIST
meta.purpose: Machine-readable tick-off list for the AI agent executing the fresh-machine run (blank Windows PC -> fully playable game with evidence). Companion to Docs/ASTRAWILD_FRESH_MACHINE_PLAYBOOK.md (the human/agent-readable spine) and Scripts/fresh_machine_preflight.ps1 (the automated readiness gate).
meta.repo: https://github.com/banksaisuoy/astrawild-game (PRIVATE - needs GitHub credentials + PAT with repo scope)
meta.status_vocabulary: NOT_RUN (default) | IN_PROGRESS | PASS | FAIL | BLOCKED | SKIPPED (with reason)
usage_rules: The executing agent updates each step's status + evidence as it goes and commits the updated file together with the evidence artifacts (Docs/ENGINE_LOGS/raw/).
A FAIL is a valid outcome: record it honestly with the raw error output, then fix-forward per the on_fail field or the playbook troubleshooting matrix.
Never mark PASS without a captured artifact named in the evidence field.
Expected numbers are pinned by Scripts/validate_final_run.py - when in doubt the validator gate wins over this file.

phases.title: Machine pre-flight (hardware / OS / disk)
phases.goal: Prove the machine can carry UE + VS + repo + build outputs before installing anything.

steps.check: Operating system is Windows 10 1909+ or Windows 11, 64-bit
steps.expect: OS row PASS
steps.on_fail: Report and stop - not fixable in software.

steps.check: RAM >= 16 GB (32 recommended)
steps.expect: RAM row PASS or WARN(>=16)
steps.on_fail: Close background apps; below 16 GB report the limitation and continue cautiously.

steps.check: DX12-capable GPU with 4+ GB VRAM present
steps.expect: GPU row PASS
steps.on_fail: Update GPU drivers; note -d3d11 exists only as a diagnostic fallback.

steps.check: At least 120 GB free on the install drive (250 GB recommended)
steps.expect: At least one disk row PASS/WARN at >=120 GB and UE/VS/repo planned on that drive
steps.on_fail: Free space or choose another drive for UE/VS/repo/build outputs.

steps.check: Administrator rights available for installs
steps.expect: elevation possible (or UAC prompts accepted during installs)
steps.on_fail: Open an elevated PowerShell for the install phases.

phases.title: Install base tools (Git + Git LFS + Python)
phases.goal: Get git, git-lfs and python 3.9+ onto PATH.

steps.check: git installed (Git for Windows, includes Git Bash + LFS)
steps.expect: new shell: git --version prints git version 2.4x.windows.x
steps.on_fail: Manual installer from https://git-scm.com/download/win with default options.
steps.evidence: git --version output in the phase log

steps.check: git-lfs functional
steps.expect: git-lfs/3.x.x
steps.on_fail: Reinstall Git with LFS checked, or winget install --id Git.Git.LFS -e, then git lfs install.

steps.check: python 3.9+ on PATH
steps.expect: new shell: python --version prints Python 3.12.x
steps.on_fail: python.org installer with 'Add python.exe to PATH' ticked; verify in a NEW shell.

phases.title: Install Visual Studio 2022 (C++ game development)
phases.goal: MSVC v143 toolchain + Windows SDK for UBT builds.

steps.check: VS2022 Community installed with the NativeGame workload
steps.expect: vswhere -products * -requires Microsoft.VisualStudio.Workload.NativeGame -property installationPath returns a path
steps.on_fail: Run the Visual Studio Installer app -> Modify -> tick 'Game development with C++' with recommended components.

steps.check: MSVC v143 x64/x86 build tools component present
steps.expect: returns the VS installation path
steps.on_fail: VS Installer -> Modify -> individual components -> 'MSVC v143 - VS 2022 C++ x64/x86 build tools'.

phases.title: Install Unreal Engine 5.8.2
phases.goal: UE 5.8.2 registered on the machine (project EngineAssociation 5.8).

steps.check: Epic Games Launcher installed + signed in (free account)
steps.command: manual: https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/download -> sign in (hand the login step to the human if you are an agent)
steps.expect: launcher opens and shows the Library tab
steps.on_fail: Retry after reboot; verify Epic services are not blocked by the network.

steps.check: Unreal Engine 5.8.x installed (latest 5.8.2)
steps.command: launcher UI: Unreal Engine -> Library -> + arrow -> install 5.8.2 (default options, default location C:\Program Files\Epic Games\UE_5.8)
steps.expect: Test-Path 'C:\Program Files\Epic Games\UE_5.8\Engine\Binaries\Win64\UnrealEditor.exe' is True
steps.on_fail: Non-default install root: setx UE_ROOT "<root>" and re-run preflight to confirm detection.

steps.check: UE_ROOT set when engine is not at the standard path
steps.expect: preflight P3 row PASS on UE 5.8
steps.on_fail: Confirm the root contains Engine\Binaries\Win64\UnrealEditor.exe.

phases.title: Clone repository + static gates
phases.goal: A clean final-completion checkout with all 586 LFS objects and both validators green.

steps.check: Repo cloned with credentials for the private repo
steps.command: git clone https://github.com/banksaisuoy/astrawild-game AstrawildGame (cd into a drive with headroom)
steps.expect: clone succeeds (Credential Manager stores username + PAT with repo scope on first prompt)
steps.on_fail: PAT missing/wrong scope: create a classic PAT with repo scope; LFS uses the same credential.

steps.check: On branch final-completion, up to date, clean tree
steps.command: git lfs install; git checkout final-completion; git pull origin final-completion; git status --porcelain
steps.expect: branch final-completion; empty porcelain output
steps.on_fail: Stash/commit local changes; never force-push.

steps.check: All 586 LFS pointers resolve to on-disk objects
steps.command: git lfs pull; git lfs ls-files | Measure-Object -Line
steps.expect: Lines: 586; git show HEAD:Content/Vehicles/SM_Vehicle_DawnSkiff.uasset shows binary content, not a pointer
steps.on_fail: git lfs fetch --all; verify PAT scope; re-clone if the checkout is truncated. NOTE: git lfs fsck exiting 1 with ~3,954 raw-pack flags is a DOCUMENTED non-corruption convention mismatch - do not rewrite history.

steps.check: Static validator (python) ALL PASS
steps.expect: final line: FINAL RUN VALIDATION: ALL CHECKS PASSED (133-test gate + census gates)
steps.on_fail: A fresh clean clone failing a gate means the clone or checkout is broken - capture full output and report; never edit source to force a pass.

steps.check: Repository structural validator (bash) PASS
steps.expect: final line: ASTRAWILD repository validation passed (v2 ruleset). Unreal compile/playtest still required on the target machine.
steps.on_fail: Same rule as P4-04.

steps.check: Full machine preflight: every REQUIRED row PASS
steps.expect: RESULT: ALL REQUIRED CHECKS PASSED (exit 0)
steps.on_fail: Fix each FAIL row per the playbook section it references, then re-run. Do not start P5 with a FAIL row.

phases.title: Generate + build (compile gate)
phases.goal: ASTRAWILDEditor Win64 Development compiles with 0 errors.

steps.check: Project files generated (optional, idempotent)
steps.expect: .sln generated, no errors
steps.on_fail: UBT builds fine without the .sln - continue unless UBT itself reported a problem.

steps.check: Editor target builds clean
steps.command: .\Build.ps1   (with $env:UE_ROOT set if engine is non-default; direct UBT form in the playbook)
steps.expect: exit 0, 0 errors, BUILD SUCCESSFUL banner
steps.on_fail: UBT ExitCode 6: capture Engine\Intermediate\Build\BuildHistory + UBT log BEFORE one retry, then stop and report. UHT errors: minimal mechanical fix only. See playbook troubleshooting matrix.

phases.title: Asset import + showcase map (V2-36 + V2-29 + V2-35)
phases.goal: All 109 real CC0 meshes + clips + theme masters imported with zero-missing reports; showcase map built; landscape material assigned.

steps.check: One-click import + showcase pipeline ran
steps.expect: editor opens on /Game/Maps/L_Showcase_ArtOverhaul after the pipeline completes
steps.on_fail: UnrealEditor.exe not found: setx UE_ROOT and re-run. Catalog warning: re-check P4-03 LFS pull.
steps.evidence: editor screenshot of the showcase map

steps.check: import_report.json total_missing == 0 (meshes AND clips)
steps.expect: "total_missing": 0 and "errors": [] - clip_map AM_ paths included (direct-binding evidence)
steps.on_fail: total_missing > 0 usually = LFS sources incomplete (re-run P4-03); only then treat as an engine finding - record exact rows.

steps.check: Sci-Fantasy base import (V2-35) clean
steps.command: editor python console: py "Content/Python/AwPipeline/import_echo_bases.py"   (or -run=pythonscript command form)
steps.expect: Saved\AwPipelineReport\echo_base_report.json: "total_missing": 0 and "errors": [] (material coverage counts - failed M_SciFi_* master = ERROR)
steps.on_fail: Record the failed master/file + error; continue if the rest imported (fix-forward on a branch).

steps.check: Landscape material assigned on MainMap (manual, V2-32 prerequisite)
steps.command: editor: open Content/ASTRAWILD/Maps/MainMap.umap -> select Landscape actor -> Landscape Material slot -> /Game/Materials/M_Landscape_SciFiFrontier
steps.expect: slot shows M_Landscape_SciFiFrontier
steps.on_fail: If the material does not exist, the import pass failed earlier - revisit P6-02.

steps.check: Showcase PIE: player in real Tier-3 Exosuit, idle clips playing, ore nodes glowing
steps.command: press Play in the open showcase map
steps.expect: real mesh pawn; display rows animate; nodes glow (V2-36 acceptance)
steps.on_fail: See queue V2-36 note - mutated PMC fallback before import is BY DESIGN, not a failure.

phases.title: PIE boot on MainMap (V-4)
phases.goal: World boots, census log line matches the expected numbers.

steps.check: MainMap PIE boots to the camp in < 30 s
steps.expect: terrain + camp + village visible; HUD Day 1 08:00, Clear, 0 RP, quest 'First Light'
steps.on_fail: Black screen: wait for shader compile, retry; -d3d11 only as diagnostic.

steps.check: Content census log line matches Appendix A
steps.command: read Output Log line 'Content library registered (live census)'
steps.expect: 78 items, 58 recipes, 229 Echo species, 26 buildings, 17 technologies, 22 quests, 11 loot tables, 13 NPCs, 8 weapon profiles, 10 resource nodes, 8 work sites, 16 world events, 17 POIs, 12 biomes, 13 dialogue trees, 3 robots
steps.on_fail: The log wins over all docs - record the delta as a P1 finding (fix-forward or report).

phases.title: Automation tests (V-5)
phases.goal: All 133 world-free contracts pass in the real engine.

steps.check: Test.ps1 run: 133/133 Result={Success}, 0 Result={Fail}
steps.expect: ALL TESTS PASSED banner; count read from the output file, not memory
steps.on_fail: Record failing test names + log excerpts in BUILD_STATUS; world-free contract failures are source bugs - capture and route to GLM unless trivially mechanical.

phases.title: Full gameplay verification (golden path + DCP features)
phases.goal: One continuous PIE session proves the whole game plays as designed, incl. every v9.5 DCP feature.
phases.playbook_ref: P9 (section 11); queue section 2 V-6..V-28 + section 3 rows + GDP/DP additions

steps.check: 23-stage golden path walked in order
steps.command: manual PIE session (~30-45 min) - stages enumerated in Docs/ASTRAWILD_ENGINE_VERIFICATION_QUEUE.md section 2 (NEW GAME -> ... -> SAVE -> LOAD -> VERIFY)
steps.expect: every stage's PASS criterion holds (damage numbers, capture chance, ghost previews, grid resolve, dungeon gates, boss phases, save/load fidelity)
steps.on_fail: Mark the failing stage + criterion; continue if non-blocking; fix-forward smallest change otherwise.

steps.check: Story tail shortcut + endings
steps.command: console: AW.FastForward Quest_TheDrownedSovereign -> walk MQ-17 homecoming marker -> talk to Maren -> choose ending
steps.expect: Ending A: cinematic plays then weather pins Clear + 'THE DAWN THAT STAYS' banner; Ending B on a second save: storm stays + 'THE STORM THAT SLEEPS'; both persist through save/load
steps.on_fail: Crown choices must appear only after MQ-17 - otherwise gate regression (report).

steps.check: DCP feature matrix verified
steps.command: manual PIE: ending cinematic letterbox/staged shots; 5 post-game quests + 5 one-time NPC offers; NG+ (pause entry post-game only, carryover + cycle scaling); Vess/Ione bodies + trees; toast A_UI_Confirm sound; journal clickable detail view (P key, knowledge-gated); gamepad LB+X smart-cast; Wavecrest/Voltmaw/Voidwing/Verdantbloom/Undertowray real meshes
steps.expect: each DCP feature visibly works as its queue/doc row describes
steps.on_fail: Record per-feature FAIL with reproduction steps.

steps.check: PCR screens + GDP/DP additions + mutation visuals
steps.command: press P/L/M/U; follow the 'GDP Playtest Additions' + DP-4..DP-9 lists in the HANDOFF; spawn 2 bestiary species from different themes (V2-35)
steps.expect: Field Journal/Roster/World Map/Hunt Board all functional; abilities/weakness toasts/dungeon identity/affinity dialogue per spec; energy-body glow vs stone matte material swap visible
steps.on_fail: Per-row note + continue.

phases.title: Save/load stress (3 round-trips)
phases.goal: Persistence proven across create -> save -> quit -> load -> verify x3, plus old-save migration refusal.

steps.check: Test_RealSaveLoad.ps1 completes
steps.expect: script completes; log written
steps.on_fail: If it drives the packaged exe, run P11 first then re-run.

steps.check: Manual 3-cycle round-trip with automation state
steps.command: manual: build base + assign Echoes + deploy drone -> F5 -> quit -> relaunch -> F9 -> verify x3
steps.expect: buildings/party/equipment/research/quest/journal/zones + work assignments + site output + battery charge + rest state all restore; automation resumes without re-assign
steps.on_fail: Capture the save file + log; schema bugs route to GLM.

phases.title: Package + standalone run (V-41/V-42)
phases.goal: Cooked Win64 package boots and plays outside the editor.

steps.check: Build_Package.ps1 exit 0
steps.command: .\Build_Package.ps1   (set ASTRAWILD_ARCHIVE for a non-default output dir)
steps.expect: RunUAT exit 0; archive contains Windows/ASTRAWILD.exe
steps.on_fail: Capture the FULL UAT log before any retry (never retry blind). Entry-map policy failure = V-41's documented open question - report it.

steps.check: Packaged exe boots to MainMap with input working
steps.expect: loading screen -> MainMap -> census log line identical to P7 -> move/gather/craft/capture respond
steps.on_fail: Capture RUNTIME log; check packaged redist requirements.

phases.title: LAN 4-player acceptance (section 22 contract)
phases.goal: All 17 LAN rows pass with host + 3 clients.

steps.check: Session flow: host hosts, 3 clients find + join (or direct IP)
steps.command: HOST: ESC -> LAN CO-OP -> Host LAN Game; CLIENTS x3: ESC -> LAN CO-OP -> Find + Join LAN Game
steps.expect: beacon discovery ~1-2 s; HUD lines read LAN HOST (N/4) / LAN CLIENT
steps.on_fail: Firewall: allow the game binaries inbound on Private networks; verify same subnet.

steps.check: 17-row LAN table walked
steps.command: follow Docs/ASTRAWILD_FINAL_BUILD_HANDOFF.md section 22 rows 1-17 (world visibility, movement, interact routing, combat, gather/craft/build, capture, party, mounts, vendor, dialogue, quests, dungeons, host save, reconnect, late join, authority sanity, session honesty)
steps.expect: all 17 rows PASS with host authority throughout
steps.on_fail: Any failure files the failing row number with logs.

phases.title: Evidence, status, closing
phases.goal: Everything captured, every queue row updated, committed and pushed; game declared complete only if honestly green.

steps.check: All evidence artifacts filed under Docs/ENGINE_LOGS/raw/ with SHA names
steps.expect: BUILD/AUTOMATION/UAT/RUNTIME logs + import_report.json + echo_base_report.json + screenshots present
steps.on_fail: n/a

steps.check: Status surfaces updated honestly (BUILD_STATUS playtest table, queue rows, LIVE_EXECUTION_STATE section 1/5)
steps.command: edit the three docs with per-row PASS/FAIL + evidence names
steps.expect: no row claims PASS without an artifact; ENGINE-RUN-1 state reflects reality
steps.on_fail: n/a
steps.evidence: git diff of the three docs

steps.check: Committed + pushed to final-completion (task ID + SHA + state + next task in the message)
steps.command: git add Docs/ENGINE_LOGS/raw Docs/BUILD_STATUS.md Docs/ASTRAWILD_ENGINE_VERIFICATION_QUEUE.md Docs/ASTRAWILD_LIVE_EXECUTION_STATE.md; git commit; git push origin final-completion
steps.expect: remote HEAD == local HEAD; no force-push ever
steps.on_fail: Push failures: check PAT scope + LFS push (git lfs push origin final-completion).

steps.check: Completion declaration (ONLY if P5-P12 all PASS)
steps.command: record final SHA + log manifest in Docs/ASTRAWILD_FINAL_READINESS_REPORT.md section J
steps.expect: ASTRAWILD declared GAME-COMPLETE (source-complete + engine-verified + packaged); the merge to main stays with GLM + user (POST-ACCEPT-1)
steps.on_fail: Any open FAIL: the honest terminal state is BLOCKED with the failing row - a documented FAIL beats an invented PASS.
